user_problem: Two supplied knowledge sources conflict and reviewers need a focused packet for an authorized resolver.
unique_output: A dossier containing conflicting statements, exact scopes, dates, authorities, downstream uses, and decision questions.
required_input: Source excerpts, metadata, authority rules, affected artifacts, and the named resolving role.
critical_rule: Do not choose a winner unless supplied precedence conclusively resolves the conflict; otherwise frame the decision.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is document-consistency-check; this packages one consequential contradiction for resolution rather than surveying consistency broadly.
acceptance_scenario: Input Handbook H says retain drafts 30 days; Policy P says 60 days; P outranks H; articles A1 and A2 cite H. Output identifies P as controlling under supplied precedence and lists A1/A2 for review.
